title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:**
  Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
Full-time
  
  
United States
  
  
Remote
  
  
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.
  
  
‍
  
  
You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.
  
  
‍
  
  
This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.
  
  
‍
  
  
Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
  
  
‍
  
  
**Why this role exists**
‍
  
  
Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.
  
  
‍
  
  
With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.
  
  
‍
  
  
We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.
  
  
‍
  
  
This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.
  
  
‍
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the creative vision – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* Sell and champion creative ideas – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* Build and implement AI-enabled workflows – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* Expand creative possibilities through AI – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* Own the creative lifecycle – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs) – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* Anticipate and resolve challenges – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

‍
  
  
**What You Will Bring**

* Around 8 years of relevant creative experience, including at least 2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows.
* An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples, demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows, combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* Assertive, persuasive communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives, providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* Strong creative and strategic judgment, grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How We Work**
Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.
  
  
‍
  
  
You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.
  
  
‍
  
  
Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.
  
  
‍
  
  
**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.
  
  
‍
  
  
**What This Role Offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We Believe Great Teams Are Built On Shared Values**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success In This Role Means**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

‍
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**
**‍**
**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**
‍
  
  
Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.
  
  
‍
  
  
Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.
  
  
‍
  
  
At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

title: Creative Strategist, Mexico
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
  
  
If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
  
  
**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**

* Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge

**You’re Probably a Match If**

* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality

**Meet the team**
We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.
  
  
**How We Hire**
We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.
  
  
When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
  
  
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above - we still want to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that all interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.
  
  
We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.
  
  
Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
**The role**
We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.
  
  
This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.
  
  
You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.
  
  
And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the department.**

* Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.
* Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.
* Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.
* Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

**Run the engine.**

* Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.
* Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.
* Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.

title: CREATIVE DIRECTOR
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

This role leads the Jack Design Studio, overseeing internal creative talent and external partners to deliver distinctive, high-quality brand experiences across every customer touchpoint. As the steward of Jack in the Boxs visual identity and creative standards, this leader shapes and evolves the brands design language while translating creative vision into compelling, culturally relevant work across campaigns, digital channels, packaging, merchandising, and restaurant environments.

**KEY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Creative Leadership & Brand Identity**

Owns and stewards the visual identity of Jack in the Box across all consumer-facing touchpoints, ensuring the brand is distinctive, recognizable and consistently executed which includes typography, color, graphic language, photography, illustration, iconography, motion and other core design elements.

Establishes the creative vision and design principles for the Jack Design Studio and sets a high bar for creative excellence, craft and originality.

Develops and maintains brand identity guidelines, creative toolkits, templates and design systems that enable consistent execution across internal teams, agencies, franchisees and external partners.

Protects brand consistency without allowing the brand to become formulaic, ensuring creative continues to feel fresh, culturally current and surprising.

**Jack Design Studio Leadership**

Creates a highly collaborative internal creative culture built around strong ideas, exceptional craft, speed and constructive creative feedback.

Establishes effective creative workflows, intake processes, prioritization and review standards in partnership with Marketing Operations.

Balances high-volume production needs with higher-order brand and creative development, ensuring the Studio operates as a creative engine rather than simply a production service.

**Restaurant Merchandising, Menu Boards & Point of Purchase**

Leads creative development and production of restaurant merchandising and point-of-purchase materials, ensuring every in-restaurant execution delivers against the brand identity and commercial objectives.

Oversees design and production of menu boards, promotional menu panels, window clings, counter materials, signage and other restaurant merchandising.

Partners with Menu & Product Marketing, Operations and Marketing Operations to translate marketing programs, menu innovation and value initiatives into compelling restaurant communication.

Develops scalable creative systems capable of supporting national programs, market-level differences, tests and rapid promotional changes.

**Digital & Customer Experience Design**

Oversees brand design across digital touchpoints, including web, app, CRM, paid digital media, social content and other digital customer experiences.

Partners with Digital & Growth Marketing to ensure the brand identity translates effectively into performance-oriented and transactional environments.

Establishes flexible digital design systems that enable high-volume content creation, versioning, localization and rapid optimization.

Ensures performance creative remains unmistakably Jack while meeting the functional requirements of digital channels.

Partners closely with Brand Marketing and external creative agencies in the development and production of integrated campaigns.

Represents the internal creative point of view throughout campaign concepting, design, production and adaptation.

Ensures agency-developed campaigns translate seamlessly into the broader Jack visual ecosystem across restaurant, digital, CRM, merchandising and owned channels.

Oversees internal copywriting resources and partners with Brand Marketing and external agencies to ensure copy reflects Jacks distinctive brand personality.

Translates strategic and commercial objectives into compelling creative solutions rather than treating creative execution as an isolated downstream activity.

Exceptional creative judgment and a highly developed eye for design, typography, photography, visual storytelling and craft.

The ideal candidate combines a strong artistic perspective with technical production skills and an understanding of premium consumer brands.

You’ll help shape the visual direction of Sportiefs Matcha across digital campaigns, product launches, e-commerce, and social media.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.
* Set the visual direction on your accounts, making the calls on typography, color, imagery, and how a piece moves the eye, and giving designers and art directors what they need to execute it.
* Make sure art and copy work together from concept through execution.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop art directors, designers, and writers on your accounts, owning the quality of their work.
* Direct and review creative before it reaches clients, giving the feedback that makes the work and the person better.
* Own your direct reports' development through regular one-on-ones, growth plans, and stretch assignments.
* Lead critiques, ideation sessions, and creative reviews that raise what the team believes is possible.
* Balance assignments and capacity across your accounts and get ahead of workload risk before it reaches clients.
* Run creative on your accounts efficiently and profitably, working with project management on scope, resourcing, and timelines.

Account & Agency Partnership

* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.
* Immerse yourself in your clients' business, technology, products, and markets, and keep that knowledge current.
* Partner with strategy so creative is built on insight rather than assumption.
* Bring creative thinking to growth conversations and contribute to new business where your accounts or expertise fit.
* Keep the VP of Creative and account leadership informed on creative health, client relationships, and anything that could turn.

AI Leadership

* Identify workflows and task types across your team that could benefit from new AI tools or approaches.
* Test and pilot new tools, evaluating quality before recommending broader use.
* Support your team in applying approved tools appropriately, including where a tool should and shouldn't be used, and make sure they have the training and guidance.
* Reinforce Godfrey's AI usage policies and guidelines, and the expectation that AI output gets reviewed for quality, accuracy, and originality before it's relied on or shared.
* Surface promising tools, risks, and adoption concerns to the VP of Creative.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* Extensive agency creative experience, including leading campaign concepting and execution across print, digital, and web. B2B experience preferred.
* Experience managing and developing creative talent, including art directors, designers, and writers.
* Proven ability to judge concepts, art, and copy, give direction that makes the work better, and execute at a senior level yourself.
* Strong command of marketing principles and how creative connects to client business objectives.
* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.

title: Associate Creative Director, Design
description:
#### **About Us**

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. Recognized by MedTech Breakthrough, the Digital Health Awards, and BuiltIn's Best Places to Work.

#### **The Role**

We're looking for an Associate Creative Director, Design to help lead the next chapter of the SimplePractice brand. Reporting to the Head of Creative & Creative Director, you'll partner across Brand, Growth, Web, Product Marketing, and Copy & Content Strategy to concept and launch integrated campaigns that strengthen our brand, drive business impact, and elevate our creative standards.

As a member of the Creative Leadership Team, you'll work alongside your ACD peers to shape our creative vision, raise the bar for craft, mentor designers, and help define how our team operates and grows. You'll play a key role in evolving our creative organization by championing AI-enabled ways of working, advancing our design systems, and helping build a high-performing, future-ready team.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role for someone with exceptional taste, a systems-thinking mindset, and a passion for making great work. You'll be equally comfortable developing breakthrough campaign concepts, art directing productions, designing alongside the team, and coaching designers to do the best work of their careers.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead creative direction and visual design for integrated brand campaigns across product marketing, paid media, lifecycle, social, video, events, and emerging channels.
* Partner with the Creative Director, ACD Copy & Content Strategy, Growth, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams to develop breakthrough campaign concepts that strengthen the brand and drive measurable business outcomes.
* Create emotionally resonant, strategically grounded work that builds brand awareness, deepens customer connection, and delivers against business objectives.
* Remain a hands-on creative leader by concepting, designing, prototyping, and art directing alongside the team, setting the standard for creative excellence through both execution and leadership.
* Help drive the evolution of the creative organization into AI-enabled workflows, scaling speed and experimentation while maintaining brand and creative quality.
* Raise the creative bar across the organization through exceptional design, art direction, creative feedback, and hands-on leadership.
* Mentor and develop designers through coaching, performance management, career development, and creative direction while fostering a culture of high creative standards, continuous learning, collaboration, and experimentation.
* Partner with Creative Leadership on team planning, hiring, onboarding, resource allocation, and workload prioritization to build a high-performing team.
* Help shape team culture, creative standards, processes, and the long-term evolution of the Creative organization.
* Build scalable campaign design systems, templates, and creative frameworks that enable consistency while encouraging flexibility.
* Maintain and evolve the SimplePractice visual identity across channels, ensuring every execution feels fresh, cohesive, and distinctive.
* Lead art direction for photography, illustration, motion, and video productions, including on-set creative direction with internal teams and external production partners.
* Collaborate closely with Web, Copy & Content Strategy, Growth, and Product Marketing to create seamless, integrated customer experiences across every touchpoint.
* Stay at the forefront of design, advertising, AI, and visual culture, bringing fresh ideas, inspiration, emerging technologies, and best practices back to the team.

#### **Desired Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in brand design, art direction, advertising, or integrated creative, either agency-side, in-house, or both.
* An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates outstanding creative taste across integrated campaigns, visual identity systems, digital design, and art direction.
* Strong conceptual thinker with experience developing integrated campaign ideas and the ability to balance creative leadership with hands-on design execution.
* Ability to connect creative thinking with business outcomes, developing work that builds brand awareness, drives engagement, and supports growth.
* Deep understanding of typography, layout, storytelling, visual systems, and contemporary design.
* Experience building and evolving scalable brand design systems.
* AI-forward in your approach to design, with experience leveraging AI-enabled workflows to accelerate ideation, iteration, and production while maintaining exceptional creative quality and brand consistency. You know where automation adds value and where human judgment and craft are essential.
* Experience leading creative on set for brand photography and video productions, partnering with photographers, directors, talent, and production teams to bring creative concepts to life.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and inspiring designers through thoughtful feedback, coaching, and creative direction while fostering a culture of high creative standards, continuous learning, collaboration, and experimentation.
* Highly proficient in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and modern creative workflows.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and platform-specific design best practices.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build trust, articulate creative rationale, and influence cross-functional partners and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality work across multiple projects and priorities.
* Motion design, photography, or video art direction experience strongly preferred.

#### **Benefits**

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

* Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays
* Mental health resources
* Paid parental leave & Backup Care
* Tuition reimbursement
* Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

For more information about our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@simplepractice.com.

title: Senior Designer & Art Director
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**
-------------------

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

**A unifying approach in a divided world**
------------------------------------------

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. **Read more**.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As our Sr. Designer & Art Director, you'll bring the CodeAI brand to life through design, visual direction, and creative ideas across every channel we use. Reporting to the Executive Producer of Creative and Delivery, you'll lead the visual side of how our brand shows up everywhere and partner with our copywriter on integrated campaigns of every size.

This role leans toward design. You'll concept alongside your copywriter, direct the look of the work, and design much of it yourself, from video and social to out of home, experiential, and everyday channel assets. We have an established brand and campaigns already in market, and finding fresh ways to express them is at the heart of this job.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------

In this role, you will own the visual direction of the CodeAI brand and design much of the work that carries it.

**Visual Direction & Design**

* Set the visual direction for campaigns and channel work, and design key pieces yourself, from key visuals to social, email, web, and paid assets.
* Bring strong typography, layout, composition, and color to every deliverable, and carry the work through to final, production-ready files.
* Design for motion and platform-native formats, including vertical video and social-first content.
* Build accessible work that meets WCAG standards across digital channels.
* Use AI tools in your design workflow and help the team keep pushing how we use them.

**Concepting & Art Direction**

* Concept integrated campaigns with your copywriter partner from first brief to final delivery, and translate each idea into a visual system that works across channels.
* Bring forward new ideas that engage our audiences and solve brand challenges, often before a brief asks for them.
* Art direct photo and video shoots from shot list through post, while production partners handle logistics and vendors.
* Direct contract designers and creatives when they're brought on, with clear feedback that raises the quality of the work.

**Brand Stewardship**

* Own the visual elements of the CodeAI brand guidelines and evolve them over time, with final approval resting with the Executive Producer.
* Be the go-to resource for visual brand questions, helping teams across CodeAI and external partners apply the guidelines well.
* Present your work to leadership and stakeholders with clear strategic reasoning, using audience insights and performance data to sharpen it.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

  

We seek candidates who have:

* 8 to 10 years in graphic design and art direction, including time at a senior level.
* A portfolio showing both hands-on design craft and integrated campaign work, with your specific role noted on each project.
* Expert typography, layout, and composition skills, with the ability to flex across visual styles.
* Experience concepting with copywriters, with produced campaign work to show for it.
* Experience art directing photo or video shoots through post.
* Experience building or evolving brand guidelines and helping other teams apply them.
* Experience directing the work of other creatives.
* Experience using AI tools in a creative workflow.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

We prefer candidates who also have:

* Agency or design studio experience.
* Experience with education, nonprofit, or mission-driven brands.
* Motion design or video editing skills.

In addition, candidates must:

* Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
* Work within the continental United States
* Pass a pre-employment background check
* Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

**OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES**
---------------------------

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

**OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING**
--------------------------------

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

**WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?**
---------------------------------------

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)  
Step 2: Interviews with several members of the Code.org team (~3 hours)  
Step 3: Final Interview (1 hour)  
Step 4: Reference Checks

*All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet*

**TO APPLY**
------------

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE**
-----------------------------------

The expected salary range for this position is $100,800 - $112,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company's sole discretion based on the final candidate's experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

* Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment
* Flexible, engaging, and remote working environment
* Paid time off: 5 weeks total, comprised of 3 weeks vacation annually, plus a 2-week winter break office closure (including Christmas and New Year's), and sick leave
* Medical, dental and vision premiums paid at 100% for FT positions and their dependents
* Option to participate in 403b retirement plan
* The opportunity to help students learn better and change the face of computer science

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.*

title: Art Director
description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**  
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!  
  
As an **Art Director,** you’ll contribute to Hagerty’s creative output by developing design and concepts that bring the Hagerty brand to life across digital, print, video and event marketing. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative Directors, writers, strategists, and other team members to develop integrated campaigns and presentation decks for business and marketing need. Working as part of a cross-functional creative team, you’ll produce work that is compositionally strong, conceptually driven, and true to our brand’s distinct voice and visual identity. You’re detail-oriented, curious, and eager to grow your craft while contributing to projects that span the full breadth of Hagerty’s creative work.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
***Creative Concept Development***

* Work with Creative Directors and cross-functional teams to build presentation decks for business and marketing needs.
* Develop concepts and campaign ideas for integrated brand and marketing campaigns across channels, including large-scale events and key business initiatives.
* Take campaign platform ideas and develop them into strong, channel-specific creative executions while maintain brand guidelines.
* Produce work that reflects Hagerty’s visual identity and brand voice, including the brand’s signature “twinkle in the eye.”
* Contribute to brainstorming sessions and concept exploration for assigned projects through research and creative development.
* Deliver work on time and communicate with project leaders when timelines are at risk.
* Seek and incorporate feedback from creative leadership with a growth mindset.
* Navigate day-to-day creative challenges by following established processes, seeking guidance from peers and senior team members when unfamiliar situations arise.

***Design Execution***

* Create compositionally strong, thoughtful design work across digital and print mediums using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma).
* Apply an understanding of graphic design principles including layout, typography, color, and hierarchy to produce effective visual communications.
* Maintain consistency with brand standards and contribute to assigned projects with direction from the Art Director or Creative Director.
* Assist with photo shoot preparation, including contributing to shot lists and asset needs under direction.
* Support pre-flighting and print production processes as needed.

***Collaboration & Brand Stewardship***

* Collaborate with clients, creative leadership, and project teams to understand business objectives and develop appropriate creative solutions.
* Regularly interact with internal clients and stakeholders to ensure work aligns with project goals.
* Stay current on industry trends, popular culture, and emerging advertising techniques; share relevant insights with the team.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous learning.
* Always keep the member’s point of view in mind when creating, ensuring work resonates with Hagerty’s audience.

**This might describe you**

* A plus if you love cars, the automotive world and are an enthusiast yourself.
* You have experience in an advertising agency or strong in-house creative department, concepting, writing, and producing integrated brand and retail campaigns.
* You can easily build presentation decks in programs like Figma, Keynote, or Power Point.
* Foundational knowledge of art direction and graphic design principles.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma.
* Understanding of brand visual identity guidelines and brand voice.
* Ability to follow creative direction and incorporate feedback effectively.
* Although you’re an art director, you enjoy throwing out headlines and taglines too.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational habits and attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player who communicates well with cross-functional teams.
* You’re curious about culture, advertising trends, emerging technologies, and new ways to tell stories.
* You enjoy solving creative problems and finding unexpected ways to make an idea more compelling.

**Requirements**

* A portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, art direction, and integrated advertising campaigns.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communication Design, Graphic Design, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and collaboration tools such as Slack.

**Over and above**

* Experience or coursework in both visual design and copywriting disciplines.
* Exposure to print production, pre-flighting processes, or photo shoot support.

* This role can be worked from any U.S. remote location.
* Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. title: Freelance Social & Digital Art Director
description:
New Opportunity! Woven Health Collective is a healthcare marketing, strategy, and science communications company, dedicated to revolutionizing healthcare through innovative solutions and collaborative partnerships. Our unwavering commitment to empathy and collaboration ensures that both our team and clients experience a rewarding journey, where innovation not only advances healthcare but also enriches lives.

At Woven Health Collective, you will be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and unlock your full potential. Come join our growing team!

***Approximately 3-month contract, with an option to renew***

We are seeking a **Freelance Social & Digital Art Director** with pharmaceutical promotional agency experience and a portfolio that demonstrates strong social-first and digital-first design. This is a hands-on creative role for an art director who understands how content is experienced across feeds, paid placements, stories, carousels, short-form video, and broader digital environments.

This is not a traditional, print-first Art Director position. The right candidate is a strong conceptual partner and highly skilled designer who can create work that is visually immediate, platform-appropriate, flexible across formats, and built for the realities of regulated pharmaceutical communications.

**Job Summary**

The Social & Digital Art Director will concept, design, and direct visual content for pharmaceutical brands across social and digital channels. You will partner closely with copywriters, strategists, account teams, and production specialists to create visually compelling, strategically grounded, and medically compliant work from initial concept through final delivery.

You should be comfortable developing both individual social assets and scalable content systems that can support multiple platforms, placements, audience needs, and campaign phases. This role requires strong design craft, a current understanding of social behavior and digital formats, and the ability to translate complex brand and clinical information into clear, engaging visual storytelling.

**Job Responsibilities and Skills**

* Concept and design social-first and digital-first creative for pharmaceutical brands.

* Develop visual systems and polished assets for organic social, paid social, carousels, stories, reels, short-form video, motion content, display, web, and other digital formats.

* Partner with copywriters to develop integrated ideas in which visual storytelling and messaging work together across platforms.

* Translate brand strategy, campaign objectives, and complex clinical information into clear, engaging, consumer-appropriate visual communications.

* Create visual territories, mood boards, storyboards, social-content frameworks, design explorations, and presentation materials.

* Adapt creative work across platform specifications, placements, audience segments, and campaign phases while maintaining creative quality and brand consistency.

* Design with pharmaceutical promotional requirements in mind, including fair balance, required safety information, claims support, reference considerations, and annotation needs.

* Collaborate with motion designers, editors, illustrators, photographers, retouchers, and other production partners to ensure quality from concept through final delivery.

* Maintain a high standard of typography, layout, composition, color, imagery, accessibility, and brand consistency.

* Participate in creative reviews and present work clearly and persuasively to internal teams and clients.

* Stay current on social and digital design behaviors, emerging content formats, platform conventions, and visual trends.

* Manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communications, fine arts, or a related discipline—or equivalent professional experience.

* 5+ years of art direction and design experience, including experience at a pharmaceutical promotional or healthcare advertising agency.

* Pharmaceutical promotional agency experience is required.

* Demonstrated experience designing social content and digital creative for pharmaceutical brands is required.

title: Associate Design Director
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well-known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

  

**WHAT’S AN ASSOCIATE DESIGN DIRECTOR AT HOOK?**

Hook is seeking a hands-on Associate Design Director to join one of our teams.

Associate Design Directors are experienced leaders who use design to exceed client goals, while working within the guard rails of existing brand marketing strategies. They operate alongside creative and motion teams, serving as a client-facing bridge between high-level brand strategy and systematic visual execution. They create robust visual languages and scalable design frameworks that power industry-leading content across static and animated mediums.

They are driven experts with a passion for making premium, ground-breaking work and a commitment to fostering the talents of the employees they collaborate with. They are fearless executors who elevate the work into new creative territories. They’re fundamentalists when it comes to digital design, but approach projects with rational and innovative mindsets, always mindful of how it looks and how it works.

Associate Design Directors are ready for hands-on projects at every stage of the life cycle, from brainstorming creative concepts with the project team and developing original campaigns, to participating in client presentations and ensuring deadlines are met, to building dynamic design systems and overseeing high-volume production rollouts that scale seamlessly across digital, video, print, and emerging platforms.

They have a well-established process for concept development, using visual presentations, storyboards, and mocks to communicate solutions to peers, leadership, and clients. They also excel at translating bold concepts into modular, extensible design systems. With expertise in design tokenization, asset automation, and end-to-end production pipelines, they ensure pixel-perfect, efficient client delivery at scale, always on time and on spec.

While this role would oversee tactical production workstreams, their responsibilities will also focus on strategic and conceptual visual design challenges for national and global brands/campaigns. With an existing design team in place, and opportunities to recruit additional talent, previous experience with team and project leadership within a rapid production environment will be a critical skill. Given the close proximity to marketing clients, being an excellent communicator and an overall joy-to-work-with will also go a long way toward success.

While this role can work from any approved location, this person must have the flexibility to work around PST hours as the team’s clients are based on the West Coast.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate a mastery of visual design across design disciplines
* Execute, manage, and govern original, conceptual, and system-driven visual design work in line with agency standards and complex brand design systems
* Build and maintain comprehensive visual design systems, component libraries, and modular toolkits that empower teams to produce high-volume assets efficiently without losing creative fidelity
* Apply design rigor to provide mentorship to cross-functional teams with the goal of accelerating skill progression
* Inspire, oversee, and provide mentorship to design staff with the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and knowledge sharing
* Fluently speak the language of design with both clients and creatives enabling effective feedback and direction
* Demonstrate emotional intelligence in all meetings and communications
* Work closely with creative staff to ensure design work goes above and beyond the expected
* Maintain and promote internal best practices around modern production design, tool integrations, automated workflows, and standardized asset handoffs
* Model a sense of ownership that elevates the standards and quality of all work achieved by the designers
* Demonstrate an ability to work on multiple projects at the same time while maintaining clear vision of priorities
* Lead projects and oversee a team to ensure that work is client-ready at all phases of their projects
* Manage direct reports to help shape and grow their careers as it relates to their hard and soft skill development

  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship in design, with expertise working on design solutions as it relates to campaigns and visual systems across multiple platforms
* Expertise in visual design with a deep focus on design systems, component architecture, and multi-channel campaign scaling
* Proven experience leading design streams, multi-format adaptation pipelines, and modular creative rollouts for complex, multi-market campaigns
* Have outstanding communication and presentation skills
* Be imaginative, collaborative, conceptual, and curious
* Have an optimistic outlook toward client revisions, knowing when and how to offer opportunities to push boundaries creatively
* Generate and maintain enthusiasm for ideas within the agency as they move from concept to execution
* Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator) alongside a strong technical understanding of digital production formats, asset optimization, and platform specs
* Mastery of Figma (variables, auto-layout, component libraries, dynamic templates) to build scalable design infrastructure and drive workflow efficiencies
* Additional programs and skills are great to come with (illustration, motion/After Effects, 3D/Cinema 4D)
* Have direct experience—and an enthusiasm for—team leadership and mentorship

  

**WHAT ELSE**

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a link to a portfolio/body of work that demonstrates a breadth of experience.

This is a full-time position that can be hybrid or remote, depending on geographic location. We're a close-knit group of people who love what we do and want to create phenomenal work.

Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, wellness stipends/continuing education subsidies and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are.

We look forward to hearing from you!
