title: Faculty Member - CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Language courses: Approximately 15-18 students
* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students
Lab courses: Typically fewer than 25 students  

**Why Join Verto?**  
***The below are for full-time Employees in the United States (benefits for international staff benefits vary by location and meet or exceed local standards)***

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation reimagining higher education
* ✈️ Work in a globally-minded, international environment
* Exposure to cross-functional teams (academics, operations, student life)
* Opportunity to grow in a fast-moving, impact-driven organisation

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Compensation**  
At Verto, base salary is one part of your total compensation package.

Final base pay will depend on your location (aligned to Verto’s compensation regions), as well as your experience, skills, and relevant qualifications. Your recruiter/hiring manager can share the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

**On-site - Seville** **— Anticipated Base Salary Range**  
€900–€1,200 per credit.  
  

* **️ Right to Work**

You must have the legal right to work in Spain. Verto Education is unable to sponsor visas for this role.  
  

* **Accessibility & Accommodations**

Verto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities. If you require support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  

**Data Privacy**

By applying for this role, you acknowledge that Verto Education will process your personal data for recruitment purposes. This includes assessing your application, communicating with you, and managing the hiring process. Your data will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where applicable.

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Verto Education is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic, including race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Experiences
description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team** **:** **Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.** **About the Role**

Dow Jones is hiring a Senior Product Manager to help shape how AI shows up across our product portfolio. This role will help build the AI experiences across both consumer products (WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch) and our professional information products (Factiva, WSJ Pro, Oxford Analytica, Dragonfly). You will partner closely with the internal teams that build our **AI agent and orchestration platform, our search platform, and our personalization platform** to ensure the experiences you ship consume reusable services rather than one-off implementations. Most importantly, you will represent the end user (whether a subscriber on their morning commute or an analyst building a client briefing) in the AI roadmap to ensure our work represents something that adds value to their lives.

The role sits on the GenAI Experiences team and reports to the Director of Product Management.

**You Will**

* Own the AI experience roadmap for one or more surfaces across the portfolio, with success measured against retention, engagement, and demonstrable user value, not shipped feature count.
* Translate the specific jobs of our users (consumer subscribers, financial analysts, risk and legal professionals, researchers) into AI experiences that do the work, save the time, or reveal insight they could not surface on their own, and ship them on reusable shared capabilities rather than hand-built per product.
* Partner with the internal platform teams to bring your users' requirements into the shared capability roadmap, and run the experimentation and measurement discipline that lets us tell retention-grade stories about AI impact.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of product management experience, preferably with at least 2 years shipping AI-powered products in production (using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent-based or retrieval-based systems).
* Experience owning a consumer, B2B, or enterprise product that serves a well-defined user, ideally one where retention or engagement is the north-star metric.
* Working fluency in modern AI product patterns: retrieval and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design, plus comfort reasoning about tradeoffs across model, prompt, data, and orchestration layers.

**Nice to have:**

* A track record of shipping on top of shared platforms (internal APIs, SDKs, developer tooling, or third-party AI assistant integrations), with evidence of partnering with platform teams rather than building parallel one-offs.
* Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP): has designed or shipped an MCP-based integration for a third-party AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, or similar), including the content-rights and entitlement considerations that distribution through those channels brings.
* Experimentation and measurement discipline: can design an A/B test, define a retention-oriented metric, and gate a release on both business and AI-quality signals.

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans for you and your family (paid by Dow Jones)
* Extra paid Time Off (30 days of holidays/year)
* Possibility to work remotely for 3 months/year (desplazamiento program) or one week of remote work per quarter
* Meal benefit with Pluxee (171€/month on top of your salary)
* Retirement Plans (Dow Jones will pay 2% of a members Pensionable Salary and match employee contribution up to a maximum of 3 %).
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Well-being Resources (200 USD allowance per quarter, Classpass, etc.)
* Family Care Benefits & Caregiving Support
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program (2,500 USD for referring a talent)

Learn more about us and our benefits click here.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including women, people with disabilities, and those from underrepresented groups.

**Reasonable Accommodation**

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at talentresourceteam@dowjones.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students

**Why Join Verto?**

**Compensation**

Final base pay will depend on your location (aligned to Verto’s compensation regions), as well as your experience, skills, and relevant qualifications. Your recruiter/hiring manager can share the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

title: BIM Modeller - AI Product Platform
description:
**About the role:**

**About Janus Digital** Janus Digital ™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. We earn only on the additional value we create. Built on 15+ years of R&D, 76 granted patents and US$100M+ invested, the platform is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities with Fortune Global 500 owners, sovereign funds and hospitality groups.

**Strategic Context** Every building we make intelligent starts with accurate information about how it is built. High-detail BIM models, and MEP models in particular, are the foundation for digital twins, predictive maintenance and autonomous building operations. Janus Digital is now building its own AI BIM platform to create, check and enrich these models far faster than traditional workflows allow.

This role sits at the centre of that effort. You will deliver production-grade MEP and commercial BIM models using AI tooling to speed up every step, while giving the Chief Platform/Product Officer a practitioner's view of the AI-for-AEC market and the requirements our own platform must meet.

**Position Overview** We seek an experienced BIM Modeller specialising in MEP and commercial buildings, reporting directly to the Chief Platform/Product Officer. This hands-on role combines high-detail model delivery with structured market research into AI tooling and platforms, directly guiding the build of the Janus AI BIM platform.

Your time will split roughly 60% production BIM and 40% platform intelligence. You will model to LOD 350-400 under ISO 19650, measure the time AI and automation save against manual baselines, evaluate emerging AI tools on real project data, and translate real modelling workflows into product requirements, datasets and acceptance criteria.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce federated MEP models (HVAC, plumbing and drainage, fire protection, electrical, ELV and low-current systems) for offices, retail, hospitality, mixed-use and data-centre projects
* Model to LOD 350-400, including fabrication-ready ductwork, pipework, containment, hangers and supports where required
* Build and maintain parametric Revit families, shared parameters and project templates aligned to Janus Digital standards
* Run clash detection in Navisworks and BIM Collaborate Pro across architectural, structural and MEP models
* Apply AI and automation across the modelling workflow: auto-routing, family generation, drawing and sheet automation, model checking and scan-to-BIM
* Write and maintain Dynamo and pyRevit/Python scripts, using AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build them faster
* Map the AI-for-AEC landscape and run structured, hands-on evaluations of shortlisted tools on real Janus Digital project data
* Work closely with the Chief Platform/Product Officer to shape platform priorities from a practitioner's perspective
* Apply ISO 19650 information management: BEPs, MIDPs/TIDPs, naming conventions and CDE workflows
* Work with the Product team on developing an AI automation BIM tool.
* Highly skilled in testing and trailing new AI tool kits to build.

  
**Requirements**

**Experience**

* 6+ years of BIM modelling, with at least 4 years focused on MEP in commercial projects
* Portfolio of coordinated LOD 350+ MEP models on at least 3 delivered commercial projects
* Proven delivery on ISO 19650 projects, including multi-disciplinary clash coordination
* Demonstrable use of scripting or AI tools to speed up modelling, with before-and-after evidence

**Technical Expertise**

* Expert in Autodesk Revit (MEP); proficient in AutoCAD
* Navisworks Manage, clash detection and BCF issue tracking
* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 and BIM Collaborate Pro
* ISO 19650, BEP/MIDP/TIDP, Uniclass or OmniClass classification and IFC export
* Dynamo scripting and working knowledge of Python
* Daily use of LLM assistants for scripting, documentation and research

**Core Competencies**

* Precision: models are right first time, with clashes and data errors caught before issue
* Builder mindset: automates any task done more than twice and shares the tool with the team
* Critical evaluation: tests AI vendor claims on real data and reports results without hype
* Product thinking: turns modelling pain points into clear problem statements the product team can build against

**Preferred Qualifications**

* pyRevit, Revit API (C#), Grasshopper / Rhino.Inside or Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs
* Hands-on experience with AI-for-AEC tools in generative design, auto-routing, drawing automation, AI model checking or scan-to-BIM
* Point cloud import and modelling to scan
* Fabrication parts (Revit Fabrication / MEP Fabrication) and data-centre or healthcare services experience
* Solibri, Revizto or BIMcollab; COBie, IDS and bSDD; Dubai Municipality BIM e-submission experience
* Prior work at a software, PropTech or construction-tech company, or on an internal digital tools team

  
**Benefits**

This role can be based in our UAE office or fully remote, within a 4hr/+- window of Gulf Standard time

title: AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Barcelona, Spain (Onsite model)  
**Contract type:** Employee / Contractor B2B  
**Target start date:** Early January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time
  
**Compensation:** €45,000–€60,000 gross per year  
**Languages:** Spanish and English

**Note:** All applications and CVs must be submitted in English.

#### **What You'll Architect**

As an **AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining **business analysis, data, AI-enabled ways of working, and human decision-making**.

Working closely with **business stakeholders and digital delivery teams**, you will help identify the real problem behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively and **translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.** You will also bring a practical **AI-first approach** to your work, exploring how **AI and Generative AI can accelerate analysis, improve processes and help teams** validate solutions more effectively.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the **intersection of business, data and technology**, and who is curious about better ways to turn ideas into outcomes.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand **processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes**.
* Translate business needs into **clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria** for digital delivery teams.
* Challenge requirements constructively to ensure teams solve the **right business problem**, rather than simply implementing requested features.
* Act as the bridge between **business stakeholders and technical delivery teams**, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply an **AI-first mindset** to identify opportunities where **AI and GenAI can accelerate analysis, improve requirements quality, support prototyping, or optimise business processes**.
* Leverage AI tools as part of your daily work to increase speed, quality, and effectiveness in analysis and documentation.
* Help teams rapidly explore and validate alternative approaches rather than defaulting to traditional solutions.
* Understand and consider **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance implications** when shaping requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with distributed teams across **France, Spain, India, and the Philippines**.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders through an active on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are naturally curious and constantly looking for better ways to solve business problems.
* You do not see AI as a separate capability. Instead, you instinctively think **AI-first**, using AI tools to improve analysis, accelerate delivery, and challenge traditional ways of working.
* You enjoy understanding business processes, questioning assumptions, and uncovering the underlying problems that need to be solved.
* You are comfortable working between **business** and **technical teams,** helping both sides reach clarity and alignment.
* You are a**nalytical and structured**, but also p**ragmatic and focused** on outcomes.
* You are **confident challenging stakeholders constructively** when requirements, assumptions, or proposed solutions can be improved.
* You **thrive in collaborative and international environments** and enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and functions.
* You are **self-directed, take ownership of your work, and are comfortable operating autonomously** within a global organisation.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with both business users and technical teams.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

##### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Business Analyst experience with **strong data / CRM / Salesforce exposure**.
* Experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.
* Experience producing high-quality **user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria**.
* Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including business stakeholders, developers, product teams, and data specialists.
* Experience operating within international or distributed organisations.
* Professional proficiency in **English**.
* Able to work **on-site in Bangalore.**

##### **Technical & Professional Skills**

* Excellent **requirements engineering and business analysis capabilities**.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business challenges into clear and actionable delivery requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working closely with technical delivery teams and understanding technology constraints and opportunities.
* Practical experience using **AI and GenAI tools** to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, requirements engineering, or delivery effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of the value AI can bring to business analysis, process optimisation, and solution design.
* Ability to challenge both business and technical stakeholders constructively.
* Understanding of **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance principles**.
* Comfortable working autonomously while managing multiple stakeholder relationships.

##### **Particularly Valuable Experience**

* Experience using tools such as **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot for Microsoft 365, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar LLM-based assistants** to improve analysis, documentation, problem-solving, and delivery workflows.
* Ability to demonstrate how AI meaningfully changes and improves your approach to business analysis rather than simply using AI occasionally.

##### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with **data-intensive applications**, analytics platforms, or data transformation programmes.
* Understanding of **data governance, data lifecycle management, and data quality frameworks**.
* Experience in a **Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar hybrid role**.
* Exposure to **industrial, manufacturing, energy, or services environments**.
* Experience working in **Agile product delivery environments**.
* Familiarity with using AI to support **requirements engineering, business analysis, solution exploration, documentation, or rapid prototyping**.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on **understanding the business problem** before defining the solution.
* You use **AI naturally as part of your workflow**, enabling faster analysis, better requirements, and more informed decision-making.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and help stakeholders explore alternatives that may create greater value.
* You balance business needs, technical realities, and delivery constraints to arrive at practical solutions.
* You can move **comfortably** between **strategic conversations** anddetailed **requirements definition**.
* You **build trust with stakeholders** through clear communication, curiosity, and consistent delivery.
* You understand that requirements are rarely perfect on day one and are comfortable working through ambiguity to create clarity.
* You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, accelerate delivery, and **enhance outcomes through AI-enabled approaches.**
* You contribute to collective intelligence by **sharing knowledge,** **encouraging better ways of working**, and **helping teams become more effective.**
* You combine the mindset of a **Business Analyst, Product Analyst, and AI practitioner**, using technology not as an end goal, but as a way to solve meaningful business challenges.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus Spain**

* **Competitive salary**, paid in **14 instalments** (option for **12 from day one**).
* **Annual performance bonus**.
* **Meal allowance** (Restaurant Tickets): **€1,800/year net,** distributed over 11 monthly reloads
* **Flexible retribution plan**: transport & daycare tickets
* **Private medical insurance with Sanitas** (no copays, dental included)
* **22 days of annual leave**, increasing every 3 years (up to 26 days)
* **14 public holidays** (Madrid calendar)
* December **24th** and **31s**t are considered **company holidays when they fall on working days**
* Continuous learning via **KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience**
* A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

️ **Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

#### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Senior Product Manager Air Reshopping - Barcelona or London
description:
**Job no:** 533107
  
**Brand:** Product and Technology
  
**Work type:** Full time, Hybrid, Remote
  
**Location:** London, Barcelona, Flexible, Homeworking
  
**Categories:** Digital and Technology, Project and Program Management

**About The Opportunity**

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager to own and drive Air Reshopping, a product that continuously monitors booked air itineraries and secures better fares on behalf of some of the world's largest corporate travel programs. This is a high-impact opportunity where your work directly influences customer savings, commercial outcomes, and how far we can push automation and AI enablement across a global travel program. Working at the intersection of Product, Technology, and our partner ecosystem, you'll take a capability with proven value and define how it scales. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact. You will report to the Global Head of Revenue Management and Pricing, and work as part of the Reshopping program led by the Program Leader, Reshopping.

  

**Location**

This role can be based in one of our major offices in in Barcelona or London. Fully remote in EU region may be considered for the right person.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and document the product strategy — the purpose, ambition and direction of the domain — and communicate it clearly across the business.
* Maintain an informed view of the post-booking cost optimization market, so that product decisions are innovative and genuinely differentiated.
* Facilitate ongoing research to understand consultant needs, customer expectations, competitive landscape, and emerging travel technology trends; share findings with stakeholders to inform strategy.
* Translate strategy into clear product roadmaps and prioritized requirements that enable the Tech team to design and size solutions and deliver. Prioritise effectively using an MVP-first mindset, balancing business impact, technical feasibility, product commitments, stakeholder feedback.
* Build trusted relationships with and gather input from stakeholders across customers and prospects, global business units, travel consultants, and executive leadership; synthesize diverse perspectives and keep all parties aligned and informed.
* Own and evolve the commercial model, so that the value created for customers is also value realized for the business.
* Shape global GTM and rollout sequencing, working closely with the delivery leader, working market by market so that each launch reflects local operational, industry, and customer requirements.
* Maintain a working view of the end-to-end process, human and automated, and identify opportunities to automate and AI enable.
* Evaluate where AI Enablement can improve outcomes while maintaining appropriate levels of auditability and deterministic logic.
* Establish and monitor quality and success metrics, including savings identified and realized, rebooking conversion, and savings methodology integrity. Define and track product KPIs to measure adoption, engagement, and delivered value; use insights to drive iteration cycles.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience owning a product and roadmap end-to-end, with measurable business outcomes.

* A track record of raising automation within a product, with the judgment to know which manual steps to remove and which are worth keeping because they add value for the customer.
* Skilled at agreeing data and process handoffs across teams.
* Able to communicate complex topics to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Grounded in corporate travel or travel technology, including supplier commercial models, post-booking servicing, and managed travel program economics.

title: SDR Manager
description:
We are looking for a hands-on sales development leader to build and run Oppizi's outbound engine from Barcelona. You will manage our SDR team, carry your own pipeline target, and own the outbound motion end to end: lists, sequences, deliverability, coaching, and conversion. If you know outbound as a craft and not just as a dashboard, and you want to build the machine rather than inherit it, we want to hear from you.

**What's Oppizi**

Oppizi is the first major multi-channel player in offline performance marketing. We have built a technology platform that enables the tracking, scaling and optimisation of flyering, door-to-door, direct mail, and insert media campaigns. We operate in 14 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Spain, and more. We are proud to work with flagship accounts such as Uber, DoorDash, Chipotle, Deliveroo, and many others.

Our tech team of 50 is AI-first and ships fast. We are currently building an AI agent platform that will power our product for the next five to ten years, led by a Chief AI Officer who previously worked at NASA and SpaceX. We operate in a category with very few real competitors, against incumbents who are growing at 5% a year.

**The role**

Reporting to the COO, you will lead Oppizi's SDR team in Barcelona and personally contribute to pipeline. This is explicitly a player-coach role. You will spend part of your week prospecting your own accounts and the rest managing, coaching, and building the systems that make the team better.

We do not have a finished outbound playbook. We have strong logos, a differentiated product, and a team that needs a leader who knows how to build sequences that land, coach reps who are ramping, and turn activity into qualified pipeline. That build is the job.

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership and Coaching**

* Manage, coach, and develop the Barcelona SDR team, owning ramp, performance, and progression
* Run weekly one-to-ones, call reviews, and pipeline reviews with a consistent methodology
* Set clear activity and outcome KPIs, and hold the team to them
* Build a performance culture grounded in accountability, feedback, and continuous improvement
* Own hiring and onboarding for the SDR team as it grows

**Personal Pipeline (The Player Half)**

* Carry your own quota for qualified meetings and pipeline generated
* Personally prospect into strategic and enterprise accounts, leading by example
* Stay hands-on in the tools every week; you should be writing sequences, not just approving them
* Run discovery calls and hand over cleanly to Account Executives and General Managers

**Outbound engine and process**

* Own the full outbound motion: list building, segmentation, sequencing, multichannel cadence, and follow-up
* Own email deliverability end to end, including domain warming, inbox rotation, and sender reputation
* Continuously test and improve messaging, subject lines, open rates, reply rates, and meeting conversion
* Build the objection handling library and the qualification framework the team runs on
* Partner with Marketing on ICP definition, ABM target lists, and campaign follow-up

**Reporting and Revenue Operations**

* Own CRM hygiene and data quality for the top of the funnel
* Report weekly on activity, pipeline generated, conversion rates, and forecast to the COO
* Run the business off data, not anecdote
* Leverage AI-powered sales tools and Oppizi's internal agent stack to raise team productivity

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* **Know outbound as a craft.** You have personally written the sequences, fixed the deliverability, and cracked the list that finally worked.
* **Coach rather than supervise**. You have taken a ramping SDR and made them good, and you can point to who and how.
* **Lead from the front.** You are comfortable carrying your own number while developing the team around you.
* **Build where there is no playbook.** You bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for it to arrive.
* **Move with urgency.** You operate fast, adapt quickly, and prefer shipping to planning.
* **Communicate with precision**. Whether it is a cold email, a call review, or a weekly report, you are clear and credible.
* **Are genuinely ambitious.** You want the next role after this one, and you want to earn it by building something.

**Why should I Apply?**

* **Build the engine, don't inherit it**. There is no outbound playbook here yet. You will write it, and it will carry your fingerprints.
* **Sell a genuinely differentiated product**. Oppizi operates in a category with very few real competitors and serves enterprise clients you already know.
* **Real progression**. This role sits directly under the COO with visibility across the leadership team. Strong performance opens the path to Head of Sales Development or a broader commercial mandate.
* **Work with exceptional people.** We are builders, not politicians. The Oppizi culture values directness, curiosity, and getting things done.
* **Join at the right time**. We are scaling across 14 markets with a growing enterprise client base and significant product investment.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5 to 8 years in B2B sales development or inside sales, with at least 2 years directly managing an SDR or BDR team
* Demonstrable track record of building and scaling an outbound engine in B2B SaaS, MarTech, or AdTech
* Deep hands-on expertise in outbound: sequence design, deliverability, domain and inbox management, multichannel cadence
* Proven coaching ability, with concrete examples of reps you ramped and developed
* Experience prospecting into enterprise or mid-market accounts, not just SMB volume
* Strong command of CRM and outbound tooling; experience with HubSpot, Clay, and Lemlist is a strong plus
* Comfortable being measured on both team output and a personal number
* Fluent English is mandatory.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate. This is an on-site role
* Comfortable with occasional international travel
* Fluency in either French, German or Spanish is a strong plus.

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation**

  

* Competitive base salary.
* Annual performance bonus.
* Employee stock options.

**Benefits**

* Private health insurance (Alan) after successful completion of probation.
* 22 days annual leave plus 3 additional convenio days.
* Two paid volunteer days each year.

**Flexibility**

* Hybrid working model with four days per week in our Barcelona office.
* Occasional opportunities to work remotely from another location.
* Right to disconnect outside working hours, except in exceptional business situations.

**Interested? Apply now!**  
Only candidates who have been selected for an interview will be contacted.  
Thank you for understanding.

title: Global Retail Health & Safety Manager
description:
Brand

Puig

City

Barcelona

Work area

Facility Management

Job type

Permanent

**Who we are**
--------------

Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.

With 17 Love Brands across Fragrance and Fashion, Makeup and Skincare, we create stories that connect with people’s emotions and are powered by a global team of over 13,000 passionate professionals. With products sold in more than 150 countries and €5,042 million in net revenue in 2025, and guided by strong values and sustainability commitments, Puig continues to grow as a Home of Creativity: an open-minded space where Creators Of All Kinds are empowered to thrive, innovate and express who they are.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Puig is looking for a Global Retail Health & Safety Manager to define, deploy and continuously improve the Health & Safety strategy across the Group's worldwide retail network, with particular focus on directly operated stores and guidance for concessions, joint ventures and partner-operated retail environments.

Based in Barcelona and reporting directly to the OHSE & Integrated Management Systems Director, you will provide global leadership, governance and technical expertise, working closely with Retail Operations, Local Markets, Human Resources and other key stakeholders.

**What you'll get to do**
-------------------------

* Review and deliver the global Retail Health & Safety strategy, roadmap, governance model and annual objectives in alignment with the Group OHSE and business priorities
* Develop, maintain and deploy global retail Health & Safety processes, standards, procedures, toolkits and minimum requirements, ensuring they are practical, scalable and adaptable to local legislation
* Establish and maintain a global risk profile and risk register for retail locations, using a risk-based approach to prioritise resources, controls and improvement plans
* Partner with Global Retail and Facilities teams to integrate Health & Safety requirements into new store design, fit-outs, refurbishments, pre-opening reviews, property due diligence and management of change
* Carry out Health & Safety risk assessments in flagship stores and other key or higher-risk retail locations, documenting findings, defining proportionate controls and supporting their implementation
* Plan and perform Health & Safety inspections and audits in stores, concessions and other retail environments, both independently and together with local teams
* Prepare clear inspection and audit reports, agree corrective actions with local owners, monitor deadlines and verify that actions have been effectively closed
* Deliver Health & Safety training, workshops and awareness sessions for store managers, retail employees and relevant contractors, in person and virtually
* Review, update and quality-check Retail Health & Safety training content, guidance materials, induction resources and operational communications before deployment
* Provide day-to-day technical advice and practical support to Retail Operations and country teams, helping resolve Health & Safety issues arising in stores
* Support and, when required, lead investigations of incidents and near misses, identify root causes, agree corrective and preventive actions and share lessons learned across markets
* Monitor Retail Health & Safety performance, maintain accurate data in corporate systems and prepare practical reports on incidents, findings, overdue actions, recurring risks and deployment progress

**We'd love to meet you if you have**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, Facilities Management or a related discipline
* Professional Health & Safety qualifications, such as NEBOSH, IOSH or an equivalent international credential, are strongly preferred
* At least 5 years of Health & Safety experience, including substantial responsibility in a global or multi-country retail, luxury, consumer goods, hospitality or similarly customer-facing environment. Experience managing a geographically dispersed network of stores is essential
* Strong knowledge of occupational Health & Safety management systems, ISO 45001, risk assessment, legal compliance, audits and inspections, incident investigation, contractor management, emergency preparedness and continuous improvement
* Technical credibility with strong stakeholder management, persuasion and coaching skills. You can influence without direct authority, build effective relationships across cultures and functions, and create shared accountability for Health & Safety performance;
* English and Spanish are a must; French or other languages would be an advantage
* Availability to travel internationally
  

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.

**What you'll love about us**
-----------------------------

* An entrepreneurial, creative and welcoming work culture
* A range of learning and development opportunities
* An international company with plenty of opportunities to grow
* A competitive compensation & benefits package

Puig is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Puig, we are continually looking for enthusiastic and committed individuals from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences to join our team. We believe that creating an inclusive environment in which you feel welcomed, valued, engaged, and empowered strengthens our business and fosters a culture where we are inspired to work hard, challenge ourselves, and be innovative in our thinking. Additionally, we believe that the diversity of our employees makes us a stronger company and better able to serve our customers around the world.

title: General Ledger Accountant

title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity  

Desired (but not required):

* Direct experience with Through-Glass Via or Through-Silicon Via metallization
* Experience with FIB/SEM cross-sections, X-ray inspection, four-point-probe measurements, or via-resistance testing
* Experience with reliability testing, thermomechanical stress, process scale-up, or wafer-level packaging
* Experience with glass surface processing will be evaluated as a strong asset
Experience with electroless deposition, ALD-assisted seeding, or electroplating  

**What We Offer**

* Full time contract up to 3 years (ASE (Accés al Sistema Espanyol de Ciència i Innovació) contract pursuant to Spanish Law 14/2011)
* Access to state-of-the-art microfabrication and characterization facilities
* A dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment
* Opportunities to work on high-impact projects bridging fundamental research and real-world applications
A family allowance may be granted to candidates with dependents, according to ICFO policies.  

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

To apply, please submit your:

contact information for 2 professional references.

title: Head of CRO
description:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on **CRO Lead** to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend **$2,000,000+ per month on Meta**, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with **3–4+ years** running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

### **The mission of this role**

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

### **Who are we?**

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

### **What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday** – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.
* **Speed Is King** – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day.
* **Work Smart** – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts.
* **Overdeliver** – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

### **Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
* Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
* Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped
* AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
* No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day

### **Key Objectives**

* Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first.
* Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells.
* Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners.
* Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
* Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix.
* Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house.
* Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, full-time
* Fluent in English
* CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must.
* Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up.
* Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages.
* Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help.
* Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency.
* Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule.
* Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin.
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
* Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience.

### **Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* CRO test plan and backlog – Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next.
* Funnels – Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV.
* Build, QA and launch tests – Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week.
* Results, winners and conversion monitoring – Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day.
* CRO agency – Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house.
* CRO reporting and meetings – Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

### **How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening

(2) Test Project

(3) Technical Interview

(4) Culture Fit Interview

### **Salary Expectation**

**USD $4,000 – $6,000+** per month (based on experience and expertise).
